content.text:
## How the queue works

- **`Web Files/rootmc-ava/src/jobQueue.mjs`** — per-job JSON under `Server Handoffs/Ava Ivy/data/jobs/`. States: `pending → implementing → staged → waiting_restart → watching | failed | blocked | done`. API: `markDone()`, `advanceJob()`, `markAwaitingRestart()`, etc.
- **`Web Files/rootmc-ava/src/pendingTasks.mjs`** — Ava’s pending check; `collectPendingTasks()` counts open statuses + emoji asks + dig slots. Cadence state: `data/pending-tasks.json` (`lastOpen: 2`).
- **No dedicated reconcile script** — use `markDone(id, note)` from `jobQueue.mjs`.

## Current open set (~2)

Live `collectPendingTasks()` → **open: 2**, both **blocked** (no `waiting_restart`):

| Job | Status | Title |
|---|---|---|
| `job-ms9p5x2i` | blocked | Ban boats (feature) |
| `job-ms9qv1q2` | blocked | Expand Root-Core-Node onto additional DB nodes |

Parked per `Server Handoffs/Ava Ivy/notes/DECISION-blocked-jobs-2026-08-02.md` (leave blocked until Alex opens a vote).

## Already-done items (no action needed)

Notes / Wave 7 already match disk — **nothing to mark**:

| Job | Status | Done note |
|---|---|---|
| `job-ms9s7pa0` | done | Worker Governance block live in hourly snapshots |
| `job-msb2d5f9` | done | Sweater/security media protocol already live |
| `job-ms9qhtmc` | done | Slack dig move / Wave 7 |
| `job-msaqcfjo` | done | Root-Skills 1.8.0 live (RCON); was `waiting_restart`, already cleared |

Left `waiting_restart` alone — there are **zero** jobs in that state now.

## What changed

**Nothing.** Queue already reconciled with the decision note; marking done again would be a no-op / noise history.

- `D:\.1 Work Stations\RootMC\Web Files\rootmc-ava\src\jobQueue.mjs`
- `D:\.1 Work Stations\RootMC\Web Files\rootmc-ava\src\pendingTasks.mjs`
